scripts.supabase:prod:link: sh -c 'test -f .env.supabase || { echo "Create .env.supabase from .env.supabase.example" >&2; exit 1; }; set -a; . ./.env.supabase; set +a; : "${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN:?Missing SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env.supabase}"; : "${SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF:?Missing SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF in .env.supabase}"; npx supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"'
scripts.supabase:prod:check: sh -c 'test -f .env.supabase || { echo "Create .env.supabase from .env.supabase.example" >&2; exit 1; }; set -a; . ./.env.supabase; set +a; : "${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN:?Missing SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env.supabase}"; npx supabase migration list --linked && npx supabase db push --linked --dry-run'
scripts.supabase:prod:push: sh -c 'test -f .env.supabase || { echo "Create .env.supabase from .env.supabase.example" >&2; exit 1; }; set -a; . ./.env.supabase; set +a; : "${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN:?Missing SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env.supabase}"; npx supabase db push --linked'
scripts.supabase:prod:deploy-api: sh -c 'test -f .env.supabase || { echo "Create .env.supabase from .env.supabase.example" >&2; exit 1; }; set -a; . ./.env.supabase; set +a; : "${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN:?Missing SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env.supabase}"; : "${SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF:?Missing SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF in .env.supabase}"; npx supabase functions deploy api --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --no-verify-jwt'
scripts.dev:api: npx supabase functions serve api --env-file supabase/functions/api/.env.local
